_comment: Golden contract 4.0.0 batch (R3). Volatile timestamps are '<TS>'; sdk.version is '<SDK>' (it is kSdkVersion, asserted elsewhere); session.*/network.* attrs are normalized out before comparison (they are #9's concern, not the wire canon). sdk.http_seam_state is canon on every item; its value is '<SEAM>' because which seams are live is a property of the process, not of the wire.
